sources.note: archives already downloaded, hash-verified against their GCS object names, audited and remediated in this workspace

selection_rule: 60 unique canonical task families frozen as manifest delivery-60-v1 (selection_manifest.csv, sha256 cb3a2c73400ff36d952dd29780383f69a55ad4569422c71471eba892b803d272); 12 connector + 48 non-connector; tasks failing all four GLM runs excluded at selection
difficulty_rule: successes out of 4 completed scored trials, success = reward exactly 1.0. 3/4 successes -> easier; 0, 1 or 2 successes -> harder. No 4/4-success task is present in this delivery.
verification_limits: Difficulty is taken from the vendor four-run GLM battery checked into each package under evaluations/difficulty/r1..r4. No new evaluations were run during packaging. QC status is the client-reported harbor check verdict, reproduced not re-adjudicated. Packaging assigns no SHIP approval.

actions.review_csv_pass_rate: Stale pass-rate claims in review.csv corrected to the count measured from the packaged evaluations/difficulty reward files. Only claims worded as a pass rate were touched; completion counts such as "4/4 executions" were left alone.
actions.local_paths: Personal and local machine paths replaced with <redacted-local-path>. Container service accounts (/home/rlgymagent, /home/harbor) are generic infrastructure and were not touched.
